resolutions.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024

To authorize appropriations for fiscal year 2024 for military activities of the Department of Defense and for military construction, and for defense activities of the Department of Energy, to prescribe military personnel strengths for such fiscal year, and for other purposes.
alternativeTitles: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024

resolutions.title: An act making consolidated appropriations for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2024, and for other purposes.
resolutions.note: A genuine FY2024 omnibus with no defence division. Correctly refuses to resolve.
